sources.snippet: YOLO11n airborne-object detector — AOD4 v6 Recovered four-class checkpoint: airplane, bird, drone, helicopter. Architecture: Ultralytics YOLO11n; checkpoint version metadata: 8.4.87. This is a historical training artifact, not a field-validated detector.

sources.title: YOLO11n AOD4 v6 — airborne-object detector - GitHub
sources.snippet: A reviewed archival release of a recovered Ultralytics YOLO11n checkpoint for four airborne-object classes: airplane, bird, drone, and helicopter. The checkpoint, original model card, license text, provenance notes, and sanitized notebooks are mirrored under release/.
